g.title: QueueProcessing
g.text: 1. Read and record the queue
What the capture script learns from Math Academy's activity page

g.title: cluster_overview
g.text: Read the course summary and completed activities

g.title: cluster_cards
g.text: Read the unfinished activities

g.title: cluster_meaning
g.text: Work out what the assessment notes mean

g.title: cluster_saved
g.text: Where these observations are saved

g.title: Totals->DashboardFiles
g.text: saved during the page read

g.title: Outcomes->RepeatFile
g.text: saved when the queue reader returns

g.title: Ready->QueueFiles
g.text: observations included in these files

g.title: Open
g.text: Open this account's activity page
Wait for the queue to load

g.title: Overview
g.text: Read the course completion percentage
and the link identifying the current course

g.title: Completed
g.text: Read the completed activities already shown on the page
Activity name, type, Math Academy ID, date/time shown, and XP
These cards are read without expanding them

a.xlink:title: Update today's XP totals and activity counts\nKeep a list of the 20 most recent recorded activities
a.text: Update today's XP totals and activity counts
Keep a list of the 20 most recent recorded activities

g.title: Outcomes
g.text: Also collect completed lesson/review results
Activity ID, topic ID, and XP earned
Remember any negative XP for the repeat-activity record

a.xlink:title: Read the visible, unlocked cards in page order\nCheck each activity's type, Start link, and progress
a.text: Read the visible, unlocked cards in page order
Check each activity's type, Start link, and progress

g.title: Lessons
g.text: Lessons and reviews
Leave their cards as they are
The queue reader does not expand them

g.title: Tests
g.text: Assessments / quizzes
If unstarted and the details are closed, expand the card
Read the detail rows, including question count,
time limit, and Math Academy's Notes

g.title: Parts
g.text: Multisteps and diagnostics
Expand the card only if its Start link
cannot yet be read from the page

g.title: Reread
g.text: Read all the cards again after opening those details
Keep the same order as the page
Keep records even for activities already underway
or activity types the script cannot handle

g.title: Common
g.text: For every activity, record:
- Its name, type, and Math Academy activity ID
- Its card and Start-button IDs, and the Start link
- Its progress number and whether it has already started
- Whether its type and link match something the script can handle

g.title: Extra
g.text: Also record the details specific to each type:
- Lesson / review: topic ID
- Assessment: test ID, all detail rows, and the card's HTML
- Multistep: multistep ID and the card's HTML
- Diagnostic: diagnostic ID, card HTML, and current course name/ID

a.xlink:title:
Label each assessment as required, optional, or unclear
Record the XP still allowed before it becomes required
Record whether the title or Notes call it a retake
Keep the original Notes alongside those labels
a.text: Label each assessment as required, optional, or unclear
Record the XP still allowed before it becomes required
Record whether the title or Notes call it a retake
Keep the original Notes alongside those labels

g.title: Rules
g.text: How those labels are worked out
'Optional until N more XP' means optional while N is above zero.
At zero, or when the Notes say it must be taken, it is required.
The script also treats it as required when it is the only activity,
has no Notes, and shows a question count and time limit.
Otherwise, its requirement stays unclear.

g.title: Ready
g.text: The queue details are ready
Next comes choosing which activity to do

g.title: DashboardFiles
g.text: In this account's state folder:
dashboard.json - course percentage and today's totals
daily-xp.json - today's XP entries, kept by activity ID
recent-activities.json - the 20 recent activity records

g.title: RepeatFile
g.text: perfect-retakes.json
Remembers lessons/reviews that lost XP
so a later repeat can aim for every answer correct

g.title: QueueFiles
g.text: The full queue and the lesson/review results go into:
selection/queue.json - the latest queue observation
journal.jsonl - a history of queue observations
queue-after.json - also saved inside the completed activity's folder
when this queue read follows an activity

g.title: Timing
g.text: The current script saves the queue together with its eventual
activity choice. This chart shows the observations in those files.
These are local files; reading the queue does not transact them into EDB.
